title: 2004 AMC 8 Problem 24
statement: In the figure, \(ABCD\) is a rectangle and \(EFGH\) is a parallelogram. Using the measurements given in the figure, what is the length \(d\) of the segment that is perpendicular to \(\overline{HE}\) and \(\overline{FG}?\)

solutions.text:
The rectangle has side lengths \(10\) and \(8,\) so its area is \(80.\)

The four corner triangles have total area \[ \begin{aligned} &2\cdot\frac12\cdot3\cdot4 \\ &\quad{}+2\cdot\frac12\cdot6\cdot5 \\ &=12+30=42. \end{aligned} \] Thus parallelogram \(EFGH\) has area \(80-42=38.\)

Segment \(HE\) has length \(5\) by the \(3-4-5\) right triangle. Since the parallelogram area is \(HE\cdot d,\) we have \(5d=38,\) so \(d=7.6.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Find the area of the rectangle and subtract the four corner triangles.
Use the Pythagorean theorem to get the parallelogram base \(HE.\)
